identity.name: Financial Times
identity.description: A global business and economics newspaper known for financial reporting, markets coverage, economic analysis and an internationalist editorial outlook.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Nikkei acquired the Financial Times from Pearson in 2015. The FT operates under editorial independence protections and a prominent trust framework despite Japanese corporate ownership.

editorialOrientation.evidence: The FT's editorial charter and trust ownership provisions protect independence; coverage is critical of governments and companies across jurisdictions.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates the FT Least Biased with High factual reporting; its editorial page is liberal-internationalist and pro-market but the news operation is professionally balanced.

economicPerspective.evidence: Strong preference for open markets, fiscal responsibility and liberal trade, with support for international institutions and market-based climate policy.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Coverage is global but anchored in London, European and transatlantic financial perspectives.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; the FT has a long record of sourced financial reporting and corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Least Biased; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Sophisticated business and economic analysis with a liberal-internationalist outlook. It is especially useful for markets, trade, central banks and corporate power.

selectionRationale: Adds depth on finance, trade and economic policy that general wires and national outlets cannot match.

feeds.validationNote: 25 items; valid RSS; paywalled article bodies.

research.researchNotes: Ownership confirmed via official FT Group page and Wikipedia. Feed item count and recency verified. Paywall and limited snippet length constrain downstream extraction. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
